correctness.rationale: For p=7, the hyperelliptic Cartier-Manin matrix coefficients are those of f(x)^3 at x^(7i-j). All exponents of (1+a x^6+x^12)^3 are multiples of 6, forcing diagonal 5x5 matrix diag(3a,3(a²+1),a(a²-1),3(a²+1),3a). Its semilinear Frobenius iterates preserve the vanishing positions, so stable p-rank is count of nonzero diagonal positions and a-number counts zeros. The degree-two involution x->-x gives Q_a:y²=t^6+a t³+1, whose differential block is diagonal 3(a²+1)I2; prime-to-7 isogeny J(Q)xP->J(C) preserves 7-divisible group and complementary three-dimensional Prym block. Smoothness exclusion a²=4 is exact; sign-change x->lambda x with lambda^6=-1 identifies a with -a; different strata distinguish isomorphism classes. Independently expanded polynomial cube and all prime-field strata; a²=-1 class in F49 is an algebraic specialization; finite checks corroborate parameter-wide polynomial identity.

final_claim: Over alg closed characteristic 7, for smooth genus-five C_a:y²=x¹²+a x⁶+1, a² !=4, the Jacobian p-rank/a-number is (2,3) at a=0, (3,2) if a²=-1, (4,1) if a²=1, and (5,0) otherwise. The genus-two quotient is superspecial if a²=-1 and ordinary otherwise; the Prym threefold is superspecial if a=0, of (f,a)=(2,1) if a²=1, and ordinary otherwise. Exactly three geometric nonordinary parameter isomorphism classes.
